text: Natural cheese is ground and heated with emulsifying salts into a smooth, uniform mass. The US standard (21 CFR 133) requires at least 65.6 °C for 30 seconds; the EU and Germany set no such figure, and factories usually melt hotter, around 80–95 °C, for a few minutes.
